# How Can I Run a White Label Property Management Platform?


You run a white label property management platform by applying your own domain, logo, and colors across the entire system, so proprietary partners or clients interact with your brand, not a vendor's name. On **Jestor** , this is the full **White Label** solution.


Operators offering a portal for owners to track their properties often need that experience to feel like part of their own service, not a third-party tool with someone else's name on it.


## What matters about branding for operators


- Owner partners trusting a branded experience, not an unfamiliar vendor name
- Consistency between the portal and the rest of the operator's brand communication
- The ability to offer a proprietary-feeling competitive advantage
- Internal teams using a tool that feels part of the operation itself


## How White Label works


- Custom domain, so the vendor's domain never appears
- Logo, name, and colors apply to the login screen and the entire menu
- The side menu is fully customizable, colors, cover, hidden items
- This applies across the whole platform, not just one branded page


## Why Jestor fits this use case


- White Label is a complete solution, not a cosmetic setting
- Works for both internal team use and external owner portals
- The underlying capabilities, reservations, finance, maintenance, remain exactly the same
- Operators can build a brand differentiator on the same underlying infrastructure


White Label element What it covers


Domain Custom, no vendor domain visible


## Frequently Asked Questions


**Does White Label apply to the whole platform or just one page?** It applies to the whole platform, domain, login, and menu. More at[jestor.com](https://www.jestor.com/?ref=blog.jestor.com) .


**Can this be used for an owner portal?** Yes, operators use it to give owners a branded experience.


**Does White Label change the underlying functionality?** No, reservations, finance, and maintenance work exactly the same underneath.
